info.title: Scanalyze Document Journey API
info.description: Authoritative additive contract for the idempotent, owner-bound Scanalyze document journey. The historical /api/v1 routes are not aliases for this contract and are not silently upgraded.

servers.description: Same-origin API. Current clients call the explicit /api/v2 namespace; the /api facade remains a bounded historical /api/v1 adapter.

201.description: The batch was created, or the same durable batch was replayed.

post.description: The durableResponse is replay-stable. uploadCapability is ephemeral, separately authorized, and is never part of the idempotency ledger. A first create (replayed=false) always includes it. An exact replay may omit it when the durable document is no longer uploadable; the client can use the owner-authorized refresh route only while the document remains uploadable.

201.description: The upload intent was created, or its durable projection was replayed with a fresh ephemeral capability.

post.summary: Submit the durable document to the canonical ingest stage

get.summary: Read the closed public lifecycle projection

post.summary: Mint a fresh bounded upload capability after owner and state checks

200.description: Fresh ephemeral upload capability. This response is not durable ledger evidence.

post.summary: Resolve a lost create response without a resource identifier
post.description: The original Idempotency-Key is scoped to the authenticated actor, customer, deployment, operation, and contract version. This lookup never creates a second business resource.

200.description: Closed reconciliation state and, for SUCCEEDED, the exact durable response projection.
Typed, identity-bound bank_statement result. Other document families fail explicitly.

ContractVersionHeader.name: X-Scanalyze-Contract-Version
ContractVersionHeader.description: Exact document-journey contract. Missing or unsupported values are rejected; there is no downgrade.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Opaque canonical UUID. The raw value is never persisted or logged.

CorrelationRequestHeader.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationRequestHeader.description: Optional opaque diagnostic reference. It never establishes identity or ownership.

CorrelationResponseHeader.description: Safe opaque diagnostic reference for support correlation.

RetryAfterHeader.description: Bounded whole seconds before another allowed attempt. Emitted only for RATE_LIMITED or SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when a server delay is authoritative.
RetryAfterHeader.x-emission-policy: omit for every other code, including REQUEST_TIMEOUT and all retry-only-after-reconciliation outcomes

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, duplicate keys, invalid headers, or unsupported contract version.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated principal is not authorized.

NotFound.description: Enumeration-safe owner-bound absence or unavailable resource.

Conflict.description: Idempotency conflict, result not ready, wrong document state, or expired operation key.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request is structurally valid but violates the closed semantic contract.

RateLimited.description: The bounded request rate was exceeded.

InternalError.description: Safe internal, unsupported-state, malformed-result, or unknown-write-outcome failure; implementation details are never exposed.

UpstreamError.description: A reviewed upstream dependency failed; provider text is never exposed.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The service is temporarily unavailable, or a request timed out with an unconfirmed outcome that requires reconciliation before retry.

contentLength.x-strict-json-type: The runtime accepts only a JSON integer token; booleans, strings, and floating-point tokens such as 1.0 are rejected before model validation.

UploadCapability.description: Ephemeral transport capability. It must never be persisted in a ledger, result, log, or audit record.

ReconciliationResponse.x-timestamp-invariant: For EXPIRED: createdAt < expiresAt <= updatedAt and createdAt <= completedAt <= updatedAt; completedAt may preserve an original terminal completion before expiresAt. For every other state: createdAt <= updatedAt < expiresAt; when completedAt is present, createdAt <= completedAt <= updatedAt.

Progress.x-progress-invariant: completedStages must not exceed totalStages when both are present

DocumentStatusResponse.x-timestamp-invariant: createdAt <= terminalAt <= updatedAt when terminalAt is present; otherwise createdAt <= updatedAt

NOT_FOUND.message: The requested resource was not found.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.message: The idempotency key is bound to a different request.

RESULT_NOT_READY.message: The document result is not ready.

INTERNAL_ERROR.message: The service could not complete the request.

REQUEST_TIMEOUT.message: The request outcome is not confirmed.

UNSUPPORTED_CONTRACT_VERSION.message: The contract version is not supported.

STATE_CONFLICT.message: The resource state conflicts with this operation.

UNSUPPORTED_STATE.message: The resource state is not supported.

UNSUPPORTED_RESULT_TYPE.message: The document result type is not supported.

ErrorEnvelope.x-error-policy: code, HTTP status, safe message and retryClass are an exact runtime allowlist; arbitrary provider text is forbidden
